summary: Implemented EXT-03 backend support with a stable in-process plugin interface and startup lifecycle controls, integrated plugin-first SERVICE_TASK handler precedence in runtime execution, routed plugin ERROR and invocation failures through EE-10 execution-error handling, and wired plugin COMPLETE output validation to EE-09 merge semantics (including invalid/non-object output to error path). Added unit tests for registration lifecycle, precedence shadowing, API compatibility boundaries, and panic reason mapping.
